messages:
elaine: quick heads-up — PR #4821 (function/tool-calling guide) has an example that breaks the SDK parser when arrays are optional. cc @tyler @sam

tyler: saw it, thx. can you point to the exact snippet?

elaine: the example under "structured outputs > nested arrays" returns `null` vs `[]` in some LLM outputs and our docs show only `[]`. tests in the SDK failed on `parseToolOutput` expecting an array. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821/files

sam: failing test trace pasted here: 
```
Error: Expected array at path data.items, got null
  at parseToolOutput (/workspace/sdk/src/parse.ts:112)
  at Object.<anonymous> (/workspace/sdk/test/toolcall.test.ts:45)
```

maria: short-term patch idea: update docs example to show both shapes and include a tiny shim snippet: 
```js
// accept null or array and normalize
const items = Array.isArray(resp.data?.items) ? resp.data.items : (resp.data?.items ? [resp.data.items] : []);
```
This is minimal and easy to copy to SDK snippet.

tyler: good. for the docs we should also add a JSON Schema example showing `anyOf` to be explicit — avoids breaking people copying the schema straight into validators. e.g.:
```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"data":{"anyOf":[{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object"}},{"type":"null"}]}}}
```

elaine: perfect. can we also add a short note in the migration guide about maintaining backward compatibility when outputs can be nullable vs empty collections? one line under "breaking changes".

sam: i can open the SDK PR with the shim + test update. will include a comment pointing to the docs commit.

tyler: i'll push a follow-up to the docs PR: - swap the single example for a dual-example (nullable + empty) - add the JSON Schema `anyOf` snippet - add one-liner to migration guide - add link to SDK patch

docs-bot: PR #4821 updated by tyler: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — changed examples + added schema snippet :white_check_mark:

elaine: lovely. @sam once your SDK PR links the docs, i'll do a quick review and ship both together. timeline?

sam: aiming for EOD PT.

tyler: i'll get docs changes up in the next hour and request review from @maria and @elaine.

elaine: thanks team :heart: small docs tweak but high impact for downstream SDK users.

maria: leaving a tiny nit: please add a short comment above the shim in the docs that explains why we normalize (LLMs inconsistent w/ empty arrays). otherwise LGTM.

tyler: good call, will add.

sam: will ping here when SDK PR is open.

elaine: cool — we'll close the loop after both PRs are green. :thumbsup:
